title: Online Shopping Privacy Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Calculate your privacy risk when shopping online. Assess tracking exposure, payment security, and get personalized tips for safer shopping.
description: Evaluate your online shopping privacy risks based on your browsing habits, payment methods, and security practices. Get personalized recommendations to protect your data and avoid dynamic pricing while shopping online.

formula: const weights = { shoppingFrequency: 15, browserType: 25, cookieManagement: 20, incognitoUsage: 15, paymentMethods: 15, accountCreation: 5, priceComparison: 5 }; const scores = { shoppingFrequency: { daily: 100, weekly: 75, monthly: 40, rarely: 10 }, browserType: { 'incognito-browser': 10, firefox: 30, safari: 50, chrome: 90 }, cookieManagement: { always: 10, sometimes: 50, never: 100 }, incognitoUsage: { always: 10, often: 30, sometimes: 60, never: 100 }, paymentMethods: { 'virtual-cards': 10, 'paypal-apple': 40, 'direct-card': 70, 'stored-cards': 100 }, accountCreation: { guest: 20, minimal: 50, always: 100 }, priceComparison: { 'private-tools': 20, 'different-devices': 40, 'same-browser': 100 } }; let totalScore = 0; for (let key in weights) { totalScore += (scores[key][inputs[key]] * weights[key]) / 100; } const privacyRisk = Math.round(totalScore); const trackingExposure = Math.round(totalScore * 0.8 + (inputs.shoppingFrequency === 'daily' ? 20: 0)); const riskGrade = privacyRisk <= 25 ? 'A': privacyRisk <= 40 ? 'B': privacyRisk <= 60 ? 'C': privacyRisk <= 80 ? 'D': 'F'; return { privacyRisk, riskGrade, trackingExposure };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your online shopping privacy risk based on browser choice, tracking prevention, payment methods, and shopping habits. Higher scores indicate greater privacy risks including data collection, dynamic pricing exposure, and financial information vulnerability.
tips: Use a privacy-focused browser or enable strict privacy settings to block shopping trackers automatically
Shop in incognito/private mode to avoid dynamic pricing based on your browsing history
Use virtual credit cards or services like Apple Pay to protect your real payment information
Clear cookies between shopping sessions or use separate browsers for different retailers
Compare prices using private browsing or different devices to see true pricing

interpretation.label: Very High Risk
